Product Features

  • Overall size: The total size of this side cabinet for the living room is 140*40*68cm. It has a moderate size and is easy to integrate into the living space, which helps with storage and decoration at home.
  • 2 Doors + 3 Drawers: Equipped with 2 L-shaped doors, the cabinet can be divided into 2 levels with adjustable dividers. Above this is a small cupboard with 3 drawers and 2 semi-open shelves. It has powerful storage performance and can meet various storage needs.
  • Completely Floor-Standing Design: Due to the completely floor-standing design, there is no hygienic dead corner at the bottom, daily cleaning is easy and convenient, and ensures that the living room remains tidy at all times.
  • High-gloss design: The high-gloss design on the front not only emphasizes the fashionable and classy appearance, but is also easy to clean and stains can be removed with a light wipe.
  • LED Atmosphere Lighting: Equipped with LED light strips controlled by mobile phone app, which can adjust the lighting according to different scenes and easily create a warm and cool living room atmosphere.
  • Material: The recommended total load capacity is 50 kg. It is made of chipboard, which is sturdy and durable, can support various items stably, and is not easy to deform after prolonged use.
  • Simple appearance: White is the main color, combined with black elements, which is simple yet fashionable and can be easily adapted to different interior styles such as modern and light luxury.
  • Semi-open storage area: The semi-open storage area is suitable for placing frequently used items and is easy to take out. The drawers can be used to store privacy or small items, making the living room more clutter-free.
  • Multifunctional and versatile: From flexible storage structures to intelligent lighting, from easy-care high-gloss optics to stable materials – each design takes functionality and aesthetics into account and thus brings a quality improvement to living room life.
  • Note: This product comes in two packages that may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before assembling!

Descriptions

Descriptions

Overall dimensions: 140*40*68. Living room side cabinet with two L-shaped doors. The cabinet is divided into two levels by adjustable partitions. At the top there is a small compartment with three drawers and two semi-open storage compartments. It offers plenty of storage space and thanks to the floor-standing construction, there is no need to clean unused corners. The high-gloss and easy-to-clean front creates an atmospheric atmosphere throughout the living room. The recommended total load capacity is 50 kg. The cabinet is white and black and is made of chipboard.
